svg.title: The APX cross-layer
svg.desc: Network diagram: APX at the center, connected to six platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics 365, Snowflake, Stripe, Mulesoft) and their surrounding tools. Markers show monitored platforms and typical audit findings.
